summary: Completed comprehensive navbar testing for Golden Pirates recruitment portal. Tested role detection (visitor/recruit/council), desktop deck (>=1280px), mobile drawer (<1280px), responsive behavior at 11 breakpoints, CTAs, language switcher, scroll-spy, admin tab switching, and Suivi hash routing. All core functionality working correctly.

minor_issues.issue: React warning: 'Cannot update a component (Nav) while rendering a different component (Suivi)' - setState call during render
minor_issues.location: Console logs show warning from Nav component being updated during Suivi render
minor_issues.impact: Low - doesn't affect functionality but should be fixed to avoid potential issues

minor_issues.issue: Admin session expires quickly, causing 401 errors on /api/auth/me after a few minutes
minor_issues.impact: Low - expected behavior for security, but affects testing council role persistence
minor_issues.note: This is expected behavior - 401 on /api/auth/me for visitors is mentioned as expected in requirements

passed_tests: ✓ VISITOR role detection - correctly identifies visitor when no gp_bottles in localStorage
✓ RECRUIT role detection - correctly identifies recruit when gp_bottles exists in localStorage
✓ COUNCIL role detection - correctly identifies council when admin is logged in
✓ Desktop deck (>=1280px) - visible with all role-specific links
✓ Mobile drawer (<1280px) - opens/closes correctly with role-specific content
✓ Role flag display - shows correct role badge for recruit and council
✓ CTA buttons - change correctly based on role and current page (POSTULER for visitor, MON DOSSIER/BOUTEILLE À LA MER for recruit on different pages, LE PONT DU CONSEIL for council)
✓ Language switcher - FR/EN toggle works on both desktop and mobile drawer
✓ Drawer overlay click - closes drawer correctly
✓ Drawer close button - closes drawer correctly
✓ Escape key - closes drawer correctly
✓ Body scroll lock - locks when drawer open, unlocks when closed
✓ Responsive breakpoints - tested 11 breakpoints (320, 360, 390, 414, 768, 820, 1024, 1280, 1366, 1440, 1920) - NO horizontal overflow at any breakpoint
✓ Critical 1280px breakpoint - deck shows at 1280px, drawer shows at 1279px
✓ Visitor links - all public links visible and clickable (manifesto, code, timeline, process, butin, status, council)
✓ Recruit links - role flag, CTA changes, drawer shows recruit code and actions (dossier, mer, taniere)
✓ Council links - CTA on public pages, deck on /admin with registry/messages/butin/public-site links, logout button
✓ Suivi hash routing - tabs switch correctly with #dossier, #mer, #taniere, #etagere
✓ Scroll-spy - active section indicators work on home page (tested code and recit sections)
✓ Drawer role card - shows correct role-specific content for visitor/recruit/council
✓ Drawer routes - all public routes accessible from drawer
✓ Mobile CTA visibility - gold CTA visible on mobile >=350px
✓ No element overlapping - logo, deck, and right buttons don't overlap at any tested breakpoint
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor React warning to fix: Nav component is being updated during Suivi component render. Check Nav.jsx useEffect dependencies and ensure state updates don't happen during render phase. This doesn't affect functionality but should be cleaned up. All navbar functionality is working correctly - role detection, responsive behavior, CTAs, language switching, and navigation all work as specified.
